# Policy-KB bijection audit — trade_in_offers_and_payoffs / task 0

Scope: charter_scope = tradein_ext_mileage_overage_deduction, tradein_ext_negative_equity_rollin, tradein_ext_payoff_shortfall_payment, tradein_ext_lien_payoff_charge, with every base policy they reference (tradein_pickup_inspection, tradein_title_receipt, tradein_negative_equity, tradein_agg_purchase_link, tradein_lien_payoff), the six variants' parameters they read, and the four task-tool contracts. The remaining base policies of the product were swept as well (whole product corpus = 67 docs, hash 759c783f…0151). Hidden doc `meta` was not used as evidence.

### Extended policies (this task)

**tradein_ext_mileage_overage_deduction** — rule/booking: mileage_overage_deduction_booking (verbatim rule incl. "waiting period … does not hold back a mileage deduction"; tool contract post_mileage_deduction_140e91ac matches task_tools: trade_in_id, deduction_amount, entry dated today, equity lowered). Baseline: mileage_overage_deduction_calculation carries the baseline rule verbatim, names both grade figures (tolerance, per-mile rate) findable on the rate card; equal-to-tolerance case = nothing. Factors, every tier:
- tolerance_by_wait → mileage_tolerance_for_longer_waits: >21 → 2000; >14 ≤21 → 1500; else grade tolerance; boundaries 14/15/21/22 ✓.
- kestrel_odometer_record (method) → kestrelcare_claim_odometer_record_in_mileage_review: window on/before offer date and ≤ 60 days; ≤ stated → miles beyond tolerance allowed, never < 0; > stated → every mile, no tolerance test; otherwise baseline test ✓; the record = latest adjudicated claim by failure date on the KestrelCare contract on the traded VIN ✓.
- delivery_delay_credit → delivery_delay_mileage_credit: completed + last cause Kestrel late; ≥7 → 60/day, ≥3 <7 → 40/day, else none; subtracted from miles charged, floor 0 ✓.
- value_band_share → mileage_rate_by_credited_value_band: <6000 0.5; [6000,12000) 0.75; else 1 ✓.
- kestrel_history_share → mileage_rate_for_kestrel_sold_vehicles: completed PO on VIN + KestrelCare on VIN 0.85; PO only 0.92; else 1 ✓.
- program_share → mileage_rate_by_purchase_vehicle_program: Premium/Factory 0.8; Certified/Certified Plus 0.9; else 1 ✓.
- Assembly (shares × grade rate into one rate; single rounding) stated in each share doc ✓.

**tradein_ext_negative_equity_rollin** — rule: negative_equity_roll_in_recording (verbatim, incl. the replaced_by sentence about the pre-inspection contract); tool record_negative_equity_rollin_4688789d matches. Baseline: negative_equity_roll_in_amount verbatim with "finance tier's maximum negative equity" named (findable in the finance corpus, "Maximum trade-in negative equity (USD)"). Factors: payoff_accrual_window → roll_in_payoff_figure_per_diem_accrual (1..7 days per diem to recording day; >7 capped at 7; not passed → quote alone) ✓; signing_value_figure → roll_in_value_figure_by_contract_signing_date (≥7 days → value-credited total; 1..6 → original offer; same day or later → equity) ✓; term_share → roll_in_absorption_by_finance_term (≥72 0.7; 60–71 0.85; <60 1) ✓; standing_share → roll_in_absorption_by_credit_tier_and_autopay (<640 & no autopay 0.8; <640 & autopay 0.9; ≥640 1) ✓; addon_share → roll_in_absorption_with_financed_add_ons (both 0.9; one 0.95; none 1) ✓; gap_share → roll_in_absorption_by_gap_waiver_level (none 0.9; Essential/Standard 0.95; higher 1) ✓. Assembly (shares applied once, before cap and rounding) stated in each share doc ✓.

**tradein_ext_payoff_shortfall_payment** — rule: payoff_shortfall_customer_payment (verbatim; bank transfer; tool pay_trade_shortfall_d2aa4d28 user-owned, unlock_user_discoverable_tool ✓). Baseline: payoff_shortfall_payment_amount verbatim. Factors: coverage_quote_choice → shortfall_payoff_figure_across_recorded_quotes (line = latest per diem × 30; > line → highest; ≤ line positive → average rounded; none → latest) ✓; coverage_accrual_convention → shortfall_per_diem_day_count_by_quote_validity (≤2 days after quote date; 3–5 from good-through inclusive; >5 after good-through; floor 0) ✓; coverage_cushion → shortfall_cushion_days_for_aged_quotes (≥7 → 5; 4–6 → 3; else 0) ✓; loyalty_credit_tier → shortfall_loyalty_credit_for_kestrel_sold_vehicles ($60 / $30 / $30 no contract / none) ✓; protection_credit_tier → shortfall_protection_credit_by_kestrelcare_level (Gold/Platinum/Platinum Excl $50; Powertrain/Powertrain Plus/Silver $25; none) ✓. Final assembly (per diem × (accrual + cushion), less equity, less credits, floor 0, single rounding) is entailed jointly by the factor docs ✓.

**tradein_ext_lien_payoff_charge** — rule: lien_payoff_release (verbatim incl. "any per diem Kestrel absorbs is paid by Kestrel on top …"; tool send_lien_payoff_9460d1ba matches). Baseline: lien_payoff_charge_calculation verbatim, with both grade figures (payoff send BD, late switch) findable on lien_payoff_service_terms. Factors: payoff_channel_window → payoff_delivery_channel_and_per_diem_window (<15000 check: Friday +3, other +1; ≥15000 wire: send date) ✓; kestrel_backlog_absorption (method) → per_diem_absorbed_by_kestrel_after_pickup (lag >2 → after later(gt, pickup); 1–2 → after later(gt, pickup+2); else deadline days with switch on) ✓; quote_refresh_relief → per_diem_relief_for_aged_payoff_quotes (≥9 → 2; 7–8 → 1; else 0) ✓; program_per_diem → payoff_per_diem_share_by_purchase_program (Premium/Factory 0; Certified/Certified Plus 0.5; else all) ✓. Assembly "customer's per-diem days = window − absorbed − relief, floor 0; × per diem × share; single rounding" carried across the relief and share docs ✓.

## kb_to_source

Sentence-level sweep of every normative claim in the 67 documents. Every obligation, gate, calculation, boundary, worked figure and FAQ answer traces to a base rule, a variant parameter, an extended rule/ladder/baseline, a measure, the account definition or a tool contract. Checked worked examples recompute correctly (e.g. per_diem_absorbed worked cases 8/6/6/5/5 days; chargeback clock cases 64/68/70/70/70; roll-in examples 3150/5000/0/5000; tow cases 149/262.50/149/179).

Items examined and judged not to be additions:
- towing_deduction_calculation: "where that purchase has no delivery appointment, no distance is recorded and no mile is charged" — a derivation from "the distance recorded on the delivery appointment"; consistent with the trip-pattern "no delivery" row; not new law.
- per_diem_absorbed_by_kestrel_after_pickup: "No count of absorbed days falls below none" — definitional, consistent with the baseline MX(0,…).
- chargeback_basis_after_lien_payoff: "a covering entry rolled into financing is not one of them" — clarifies "customer payment entry"; entailed.
- agreement/one_open/trade_link/written_offer "read from Kestrel's own record … before …" sentences — the evidence_contract (system_record, pre_action); "details the customer supplies at acceptance" — caller_statement authority.
- negative_equity_roll_in_recording "The finance contract itself | Not changed by the recording" — tool contract.

Two prerequisite-side checks: (1) cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, call X first") — none; (2) a task's opening world state written as policy fact — none (all examples are marked hypothetical; no customer, VIN, amount or date of either task appears).

Additions / rewrites / omissions: **none found**.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED. First revision; no earlier revision exists.

Policy-side notes (not KB defects, recorded per Step 4):
1. tradein_title_receipt's clause "A title-delay chargeback may be taken only after the title delay chargeback days … have passed with no title received date." is declared retired (by the mileage and towing extended policies, whose replaced_by texts concern exclusion of those deductions from the waiting period) while tradein_ext_title_delay_chargeback restates the identical sentence as its own rule. The KB faithfully shows the sentence as retired in title_receipt_and_chargeback_period and in force in title_delay_chargeback_posting; a reader sees the same sentence both ways. The source uses an overwrite to express an exclusion rather than a supersession.
2. The action-form edge (payoff waits on the customer's payment) is the source's declared fallback; the scored payment (856.80) is fixed by its own computation, not by the gap to the payoff charge (747.95) — a policy design choice, carried faithfully.

## dependency_form

Sweep of every sentence carrying an ordering/dependency connective across the 67 documents (only after / not until / until / before / first / then / waits / once):
- The four prerequisite sentences appear exactly once each, verbatim, in the blocked hub, in their declared form.
- lien_payoff_release "Put the other way round: a payoff charge that the trade equity does not cover waits for the customer's own payment of whatever part of the shortfall no financing roll-in covers." — same-form (action) restatement of its own prerequisite sentence in the same document; not RED.
- payoff_shortfall_customer_payment heading "Ledger entries the payment figure rests on" + "Both are read from the agreement's own history: the payment amount is worked out against a ledger that already shows those entries where they are owed." — state-form restatement of the blocked policy's own two sentences in its own document; names no action, performer, tool or other document; not an aggregation across problems.
- mileage_overage_deduction_booking / towing_fee_deduction_booking "The waiting period after pickup that holds back a title-delay chargeback does not hold back a …" — the source's own replaced_by text in the policy's own rule; states a non-dependency, no order between problems.
- negative_equity_roll_in_recording "… so the roll-in is recorded without waiting for the contract to itemise it." — source rule text; no cross-problem order.
- lien_payoff_rules "When negative equity must be cleared first, the payoff is sent only after the shortfall has been covered under the negative equity rule" and lien_payoff_service_terms row "Payoff is sent only after any negative equity has been covered" — base law/parameter rendered as the source has it (policy-side, not judged here).
- No other problem's tool name in any blocked document; no route, checklist, roadmap, step list across problems; no FAQ/example walks across problems; no wrong-vs-right contrast of the chain.
- Titles: all name general subjects ("Sending the Lien Payoff on a Traded Vehicle", "Customer Payment of a Payoff Shortfall", "Mileage Overage Deductions on Trade-In Agreements", "Negative Equity Roll-In to Kestrel Auto Finance", …); none mirrors this task's situation.
- Computation documents (mileage_overage_deduction_calculation, negative_equity_roll_in_amount, payoff_shortfall_payment_amount, lien_payoff_charge_calculation) contain no "unless otherwise provided", pointer, exception list or hint of modification; factor documents name no computation document and no other factor document, state no tier any customer falls on, and write no task's evidence rows.
- Findability: each depended-on document is reachable through the words the sentence and the records use ("mileage deduction", "inspected mileage", "stated mileage"; "negative equity rolled into financing" / `rolled_into_financing`; "customer payment" / "shortfall"). Each factor document is reachable from record words (KestrelCare contract and claims on the traded VIN, delivery method/slip/cause, PO program, completed PO on the VIN, contract date/term/tier/autopay, GAP level, financed add-ons, quote dates and amounts, latest deduction posting date) — confirmed in the blind audit.

Verdict: **PASS** (no KB-EXPLICIT RED).
